title: Castle Itter: The Day Americans and Germans Fought Side by Side
summary: On the fifth of May, nineteen forty-five, at Castle Itter in Austria's Tyrol region, a mixed unit under the command of an American lieutenant and a Wehrmacht major defended the French statesmen held in the castle together against an SS assault. The episode examines the only battle of the war's final days in which German and American soldiers shared the same trench.
